description: This file defines the CloudZeroLogger class for exporting usage data to CloudZero's API, including methods for data export, dry runs, and background job initialization. It interacts with database, transformation, and streaming modules, and manages scheduled exports.

classes.name: CloudZeroLogger
classes.description: A logger class for exporting usage data to CloudZero, with methods for data export, dry run, and scheduled background job setup.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the CloudZeroLogger with configuration from parameters or environment variables.

methods.name: initialize_cloudzero_export_job
methods.description: Handles the scheduled export job, ensuring only one pod exports data at a time if using redis cache.

methods.name: _hourly_usage_data_export
methods.description: Exports usage data for the past hour to CloudZero.

methods.name: export_usage_data
methods.description: Exports usage data to CloudZero, including data retrieval, transformation, and transmission.

methods.name: dry_run_export_usage_data
methods.description: Performs a dry run to show what data would be exported without sending it.

methods.name: _display_cbf_data_on_screen
methods.description: Displays transformed CBF data in a formatted table and summary.

methods.name: init_cloudzero_background_job
methods.description: Sets up a scheduled background job to periodically export data to CloudZero.
